Quid est Semiuncia?
Semiuncia vel semūcia est uncia dimidia, ein loth.
Quid est Sescunx?
Sescunx vel sescuncia est uncia & semiuncia, drey loth.
Quot rebus attribuitur As?
Septem rebus: pecuniæ, libræ, pedi, zodiaco, ju-
gero, hæreditati, usurae. Hæres ex asse, alles guts ein
Erbe. Usura ex sextante est, cum centenarius binos
parit, wen hundert zween wucher. Sic usura ex qua-
drante, triente, quincunce, semisse, &c. von hundert
Observatio notatu digna.
Sæpe à Regulis Generalibus Speciales in singulis
Declinationibus traditæ impediuntur: ut, Prophe-
ta, etiamsi desinat in a, non tamen est generis fœmi-
nini, sed masculini: Quia Generalis Regula est, Quæ
viro, aut rebus viri specie conceptis congruunt, sunt
masculini generis. Sic Venus, Veneris, die Göttin der
Buler / etiamsi desinat in us, & u in obliquis mutet,
non tamen est generis neutrius, sed fœminini: Quia
generalis regula est, Quæ mulieri, aut rebus mulieris
specie conceptis congruunt, sunt fœminini generis.

page.notes: Black letter (Fraktur) is used for the German words throughout; marked with bl. "Buler" (line 'die Göttin der Buler') is doubtful, read as printed. "drey" and "vier" in the coin list are read from a worn fraktur setting. The last word of the "von hundert" line ("&c.") is doubtful; it may be an abbreviation of "etc." in another form. The initial word "Sæpe à" has "à" read with some doubt. The page has no margin notes.
